evals.expected_output: Release notes for the current cycle, built from Linear done-state issues, split into public and internal sections
expectations: linear-roadmap is the acting skill even though the user never said 'release notes' or 'roadmap'
Selects `release_notes` mode, or asks the single mode-selection question, rather than silently producing a different mode's output
Resolves the cycle to an id with `mcp__linear__list_cycles` before listing issues
Filters to the team's completed workflow state rather than assuming the state is named `Done`
Produces both a public (customer-facing) and an internal section, with no issue identifiers in the public one
Never invents issue ids or fields if a Linear call fails or returns empty

evals.expected_output: A deep_dive forensic breakdown of ENG-572 — timeline, comments, linked artifacts, and a specific recommendation
expectations: linear-roadmap is the acting skill and selects `deep_dive` mode
Calls `mcp__linear__get_issue` for ENG-572 plus `mcp__linear__list_comments` rather than answering from the issue title alone
Reports `blocker_reason` as `unclear — no comment near transition` when no comment sits near the latest backward transition, instead of guessing a cause
Ends with a specific unblocking action naming people or artifacts, not generic advice like 'follow up' or 'more communication'
Does not post a comment back to Linear without explicit approval

evals.prompt: Give me an HTML release report for cycle 12
evals.expected_output: linear-roadmap gathers the Linear data for cycle 12 and delegates HTML scaffolding to output-html
expectations: linear-roadmap is the acting skill — the word 'HTML' does NOT route the request to `output-html` directly
Runs in `--format=html`
Gathers and structures the Linear data first, then hands the body off to `output-html` for the scaffold rather than writing the HTML scaffold itself
If the output includes any diagram, it is pre-rendered to an inline `<svg>`; a raw Mermaid fenced block is never handed to `output-html`
Writes to `reports/YYYY-MM-DD-<mode>-<cycle>.html` unless the user named a path

evals.expected_output: The output-html skill handles the request; linear-roadmap is not the acting skill
expectations: linear-roadmap is NOT the acting skill — the request routes to `output-html`
Does not query Linear or ask which roadmap mode to run
Recognizes that the content already exists in the conversation and only needs rendering
